u3l1.title: Update play_count
u3l1.story: Start play_count at 100. Add 25 to it (store the new value back in play_count), then print play_count.

u3l1.title: Update likes
u3l1.story: Start likes at 4000. Add 50 to it (store the new value back in likes), then print likes.

u3l1.title: Copy old_price into sale_price
u3l1.story: Store 60 in old_price. Copy old_price into sale_price. Then change old_price to 45. Print sale_price. (The copy keeps the OLD value.)

u3l1.title: Copy level into saved_level
u3l1.story: Store 3 in level. Copy level into saved_level. Then change level to 4. Print saved_level. (The copy keeps the OLD value.)

u3l1.title: Store the song facts
u3l1.story: Spotify needs a script that stores three facts about ONE song: its title (Blinding Lights), its artist (The Weeknd), and its play count (4000000). Then it prints only the title. Name the variables the way the style guide says: lowercase words joined by underscores, no spaces, never starting with a digit.

u3l1.title: Store three facts, print song_title
u3l1.story: Store three facts about one item: song_title is "Flowers", artist_name is "Miley Cyrus", and play_count is 2000000. Then print only song_title.

u3l1.title: Store three facts, print video_title
u3l1.story: Store three facts about one item: video_title is "Minecraft Speedrun", channel_name is "Dream", and view_count is 900000. Then print only video_title.

u3l1.title: Print two labeled facts
u3l1.story: Spotify wants a card with two labeled facts. Store the song length in seconds (200) and the rating (4.8). Then print the label LENGTH IN SECONDS followed by the length, then the label RATING followed by the rating, each on its own line. Only legal variable names will work.

u3l1.title: Print length_seconds and rating with labels
u3l1.story: Store 200 in length_seconds and 4.8 in rating. Print the label LENGTH, then length_seconds, then the label RATING, then rating, each on its own line.

u3l1.title: Print battery_level and screen_time with labels
u3l1.story: Store 85 in battery_level and 3.5 in screen_time. Print the label BATTERY, then battery_level, then the label SCREEN TIME, then screen_time, each on its own line.

u3l2.title: Work out discount
u3l2.story: Store 40 in price. Multiply it by 0.25 to get discount, and print discount.

u3l2.title: Work out tip
u3l2.story: Store 80 in bill. Multiply it by 0.5 to get tip, and print tip.

u3l2.title: Store a yes/no and a number
u3l2.story: Store True in is_online and the whole number 128 in players. Print is_online, then print players.

u3l2.title: Store a yes/no and a number
u3l2.story: Store True in has_wifi and the whole number 3 in bars. Print has_wifi, then print bars.

u3l2.title: One more charge cycle
u3l2.story: The phone just finished one more charge cycle. Start the cycle count at 312, add 1 to it, then print the label CYCLES and, on the next line, the new count.

u3l2.title: Add one to level
u3l2.story: Start level at 7. Add 1 to it. Print the label LEVEL, then print level.

u3l2.title: Add one to wins
u3l2.story: Start wins at 19. Add 1 to it. Print the label WINS, then print wins.

u3l2.title: Battery page facts
u3l2.story: Apple's Battery Health page needs four facts about one phone: its model name (text), its charge cycles (a whole number), its battery health (a decimal number), and whether it is charging (True or False). Store all four, then print the model name, then the battery health.

u3l2.title: Store four kinds of value
u3l2.story: Store four facts: dish_name is the text "Spicy Chicken", calories is the whole number 450, price is the decimal number 5.5, and is_combo is False. Then print dish_name and price.

u3l2.title: Store four kinds of value
u3l2.story: Store four facts: game_title is the text "Hades", hours_played is the whole number 42, rating is the decimal number 4.8, and is_installed is True. Then print game_title and rating.

u3l3.title: Ask, then print player
u3l3.story: Ask the user "Player name? " and store the answer in player. Then print "Welcome, " joined to player. (The user types Mia.)

u3l3.title: Ask, then print city
u3l3.story: Ask the user "Which city? " and store the answer in city. Then print "Weather for " joined to city. (The user types Atlanta.)

u3l3.title: Name on the order
u3l3.story: The Chick-fil-A kiosk asks for a name. Ask the question Name for the order? , store the typed name in a variable, then print Order for followed by the name on one line. (In this example the customer types Sam.)

u3l3.title: Print a full name
u3l3.story: Ask "First: " and "Last: ", storing the answers in first and last. Print them with a space between. (The user types Gabe then Newell.)

u3l3.title: Print a full name
u3l3.story: Ask "First: " and "Last: ", storing the answers in given and family. Print them with a space between. (The user types Ada then Lovelace.)

u3l3.title: Work out the tax
u3l3.story: Ask "Price: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in price. Store 25 percent of it (price * 0.25) in tax and print the label Tax: and then, on the next line, print tax. (The user types 20.)

u3l3.title: Work out the tax
u3l3.story: Ask "Price: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in cost. Store 25 percent of it (cost * 0.25) in fee and print the label Tax: and then, on the next line, print fee. (The user types 40.)

u3l3.title: Total cost
u3l3.story: Ask "How many tickets? " and turn the answer into a whole number in tickets. Each one costs 12 dollars: store tickets * 12 in cost, and print the label Total: and then, on the next line, print cost. (The user types 4.)

u3l3.title: Total cost
u3l3.story: Ask "How many slices? " and turn the answer into a whole number in slices. Each one costs 3 dollars: store slices * 3 in bill, and print the label Total: and then, on the next line, print bill. (The user types 6.)

u3l3.title: Sandwich total
u3l3.story: Each sandwich costs 5 dollars. Ask how many sandwiches the customer wants, turn the answer into a whole number, multiply it by 5 for the total, and print the label Total: and then, on the next line, print the amount. (The customer types 3.)

u3l4.title: Number in a message
u3l4.story: Store 10 in score. Turn it into text, join it to "Score: ", store the result in msg, and print msg.

u3l4.title: Number in a message
u3l4.story: Store 7 in level. Turn it into text, join it to "Level ", store the result in line, and print line.

u3l4.title: Join digits as text
u3l4.story: Store 3 in tens and 4 in ones. Print the two digits joined side by side as text. (Do not add them.)

u3l4.title: Join digits as text
u3l4.story: Store 9 in hour and 45 in minute. Print the two digits joined side by side as text. (Do not add them.)

u3l4.title: Purchase receipt line
u3l4.story: Steam needs one receipt line. Store the game name (Hades) and its price (24.99), then print ONE line that reads: Bought Hades for $24.99 (join the pieces together; the price has to be turned into text first).

u3l4.title: Build a receipt line
u3l4.story: Store "Flowers" in song and 2000000 in plays. Print ONE line that joins "Now playing ", then song, then " plays: ", then plays. (The number has to be turned into text with str() first.)

u3l4.title: Build a receipt line
u3l4.story: Store "Hoodie" in shirt and 35 in cost. Print ONE line that joins "Item: ", then shirt, then " costs $", then cost. (The number has to be turned into text with str() first.)

u3l4.title: Full name
u3l4.story: Steam shows full names. Store the first name (Gabe) and the last name (Newell), join them with a space between them, store the result in full, and print it.

u3l4.title: Join given and family
u3l4.story: Store "Ada" in given and "Lovelace" in family. Join them with a space between and store the result in whole. Print whole.

u3l4.title: Join fn and ln
u3l4.story: Store "Mia" in fn and "Chen" in ln. Join them with a space between and store the result in name. Print name.

u3l5.title: Character at index 2
u3l5.story: Store "HMX7Q2" in code. Store the character at index 2 in pick and print pick.

u3l5.title: First letter badge
u3l5.story: TikTok makes a badge from the username dance_queen. Store the username, store its first character in first_letter, and print first_letter.

u3l5.title: First character of word
u3l5.story: Store "pixel" in word. Store its first character in first and print first.

u3l5.title: First character of handle
u3l5.story: Store "zebra99" in handle. Store its first character in initial and print initial.

u3l5.title: Character at index 3
u3l5.story: Store "python" in word. Store the character at index 3 in ch and print ch.

u3l5.title: Last character using len
u3l5.story: Store "python" in word. Store its length in size. Then store the LAST character in last (use size to find it) and print last.

u3l5.title: Last character using len
u3l5.story: Store "hello" in tag. Store its length in count. Then store the LAST character in end (use count to find it) and print end.

u3l5.title: First and last
u3l5.story: Store the username dance_queen. Store its first character in first_letter and its last character in last_letter, then print Badge: followed by the two letters joined together.

u3l5.title: First and last character
u3l5.story: Store "pixel" in word. Store its first character in a and its last character in z (use a negative index). Print Badge: followed by a and z joined together.

u3l5.title: First and last character
u3l5.story: Store "zebra99" in handle. Store its first character in head and its last character in tail (use a negative index). Print Badge: followed by head and tail joined together.

u3l6.title: Code prefix
u3l6.story: Airbnb confirmation codes start with a 3-character prefix. Store the code HMX7Q2R9, store its first three characters in prefix, and print the prefix.

u3l6.title: First 4 characters
u3l6.story: Store "AB12CD34" in code. Store the first 4 characters in start and print start.

u3l6.title: First 2 characters
u3l6.story: Store "QZ9981" in ticket. Store the first 2 characters in head and print head.

u3l6.title: End of the code from index 4
u3l6.story: Store "HMX7Q2R9" in confirmation. Store everything from index 4 to the end in end and print end.

u3l6.title: End of the code from index 4
u3l6.story: Store "AB12CD34" in code. Store everything from index 4 to the end in tail and print tail.

u3l6.title: Slice 2 to 5
u3l6.story: Store "HMX7Q2R9" in code. Store the slice from index 2 up to (but not including) index 5 in middle and print middle.

u3l6.title: Slice 1 to 4
u3l6.story: Store "telephone" in word. Store the slice from index 1 up to (but not including) index 4 in part and print part.

u3l6.title: Split the code
u3l6.story: Store the code HMX7Q2R9. Store its first three characters in start, and the characters from index 4 to the end in end. Then print start, a dash, and end on one line.

u3l6.title: Start, dash, end
u3l6.story: Store "AB12CD34" in code. Store the first 2 characters in first and the characters from index 5 to the end in last. Print first, a dash, then last on one line.

u3l6.title: Start, dash, end
u3l6.story: Store "QZ9981" in ticket. Store the first 3 characters in a and the characters from index 3 to the end in b. Print a, a dash, then b on one line.

u3l7.title: Find "."
u3l7.story: Store "$24.99" in price. Use .find to get the position of "." and store it in dot. Print dot.

u3l7.title: Find a space
u3l7.story: Store "hello world" in text. Use .find to get the position of a space and store it in space. Print space.

u3l7.title: Where is the @?
u3l7.story: Gmail needs to know where the @ sign is. Store the address sam@gmail.com, use .find to get the position of the @, and print that position.

u3l7.title: Look for a missing letter
u3l7.story: Store "banana" in word. Look for "z" (it is not in the text) with .find and store the answer in pos. Print Found at followed by pos. (The answer is -1 when the text is not found.)

u3l7.title: Look for a missing letter
u3l7.story: Store "python" in text. Look for "q" (it is not in the text) with .find and store the answer in spot. Print Found at followed by spot. (The answer is -1 when the text is not found.)

u3l7.title: Part before a space
u3l7.story: Store "Gabe Newell" in line. Find the position of a space and store it in space. Store everything BEFORE it in first and print first.

u3l7.title: Part after a space
u3l7.story: Store "Gabe Newell" in line. Find the position of a space and store it in space. Store everything AFTER it (not including it) in last and print last.

u3l7.title: Pull out the username
u3l7.story: Store sam@gmail.com, find the position of the @, store everything BEFORE the @ in username, and print the username.

u3l7.title: Part before "-"
u3l7.story: Store "AB-1234" in code. Find the position of "-" and store it in dash. Store everything BEFORE it in prefix and print prefix.

u3l7.title: Part after "@"
u3l7.story: Store "sam@gmail.com" in email. Find the position of "@" and store it in at. Store everything AFTER it (not including it) in domain and print domain.

u3l8.title: Tip calculator
u3l8.story: DoorDash: ask for the bill, turn the answer into a decimal number, multiply it by 0.2 for a 20 percent tip, and print Tip: followed by the tip. (The customer types 20.)

u3l8.title: Tip calculator
u3l8.story: Ask "Bill: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in meal. Store 20 percent of it (meal * 0.2) in tip_amount and print Tip: followed by tip_amount. (The user types 45.)

u3l8.title: Tip calculator
u3l8.story: Ask "Bill: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in check. Store 20 percent of it (check * 0.2) in gratuity and print Tip: followed by gratuity. (The user types 60.)

u3l8.title: Price plus tax
u3l8.story: Ask "Price: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in price. Store the 25 percent tax (price * 0.25) in tax, store price + tax in total, and print total. (The user types 20.)

u3l8.title: Price plus tax
u3l8.story: Ask "Price: " and turn the answer into a decimal number in cost. Store the 25 percent tax (cost * 0.25) in fee, store cost + fee in final, and print final. (The user types 40.)

u3l8.title: Bill plus tip
u3l8.story: Ask for the bill (as a decimal number), work out the 20 percent tip, add the tip to the bill to get the total, and print Total: followed by the total. (The customer types 20.)

u3l8.title: Difference of two numbers
u3l8.story: Ask "First: " and "Second: ", turning both answers into whole numbers in a and b. Store a - b in diff and print diff. (The user types 4 then 8.)

u3l8.title: Area of a rectangle
u3l8.story: Ask "Width: " and "Height: ", turning both answers into whole numbers in width and height. Store width * height in area and print Area: followed by area. (The user types 4 then 5.)

u3l8.title: Area of a rectangle
u3l8.story: Ask "Width: " and "Height: ", turning both answers into whole numbers in w and h. Store w * h in space and print Area: followed by space. (The user types 3 then 7.)

u3l9.title: Divide mins by 60
u3l9.story: Store 90 in mins. Store mins / 60 in hrs, and print "Hours: " followed by hrs.

u3l9.title: Divide seconds by 60
u3l9.story: Store 180 in seconds. Store seconds / 60 in minutes, and print "Minutes: " followed by minutes.

u3l9.title: Hours watched
u3l9.story: Store 150 minutes watched. Convert it to hours by dividing by 60, and print Hours watched: followed by the hours.

u3l9.title: Average views
u3l9.story: YouTube: store 1200 total views and 5 videos. Divide the views by the videos to get the average views per video (a decimal number) and print it.

u3l9.title: Divide plays by songs
u3l9.story: Store 900 in plays and 6 in songs. Divide plays by songs and store the result in per_song. Print per_song.

u3l9.title: Divide points by games
u3l9.story: Store 240 in points and 8 in games. Divide points by games and store the result in per_game. Print per_game.

u3l9.title: Split evenly
u3l9.story: Store 90 in total and 4 in friends. Divide total by friends, store the result in share, and print share.

u3l9.title: Split evenly
u3l9.story: Store 60 in bill and 8 in people. Divide bill by people, store the result in each, and print each.

u3l9.title: Work out a percentage
u3l9.story: Store 15 in wins and 20 in games. Store wins / games * 100 in rate, and print "Win rate: " followed by rate.

u3l9.title: Work out a percentage
u3l9.story: Store 45 in likes and 60 in views. Store likes / views * 100 in pct, and print "Like rate: " followed by pct.

u3l10.title: Days to whole weeks
u3l10.story: Store 30 in days. Use // 7 to get the whole weeks in weeks and print weeks.

u3l10.title: Days to whole weeks
u3l10.story: Store 45 in d. Use // 7 to get the whole weeks in w and print w.

u3l10.title: Whole minutes
u3l10.story: Store 200 in seconds. Use // 60 to get the whole minutes in minutes, and print "Minutes: " followed by minutes.

u3l10.title: Whole minutes
u3l10.story: Store 125 in secs. Use // 60 to get the whole minutes in mins, and print "Whole minutes: " followed by mins.

u3l10.title: Full boxes
u3l10.story: UPS packs 10 packages to a box. Store 47 packages and 10 per box. Use floor division (//) to get the number of FULL boxes, and print it.

u3l10.title: Full groups
u3l10.story: Store 100 in items and 12 in per_crate. Use // to find how many FULL groups of per_crate fit in items, store that in crates, and print crates.

u3l10.title: Full groups
u3l10.story: Store 50 in eggs and 12 in per_carton. Use // to find how many FULL groups of per_carton fit in eggs, store that in cartons, and print cartons.

u3l10.title: Pallets
u3l10.story: A pallet holds 48 items. Store 250 items and the pallet size, use floor division (//) to get the number of full pallets, and print Pallets: followed by that number.

u3l10.title: Full pallets
u3l10.story: Store 90 in boxes and 20 in truck_size. Use // to find the full pallets in trucks, and print Pallets: followed by trucks.

u3l10.title: Full pallets
u3l10.story: Store 130 in cars and 40 in lot_size. Use // to find the full pallets in lots, and print Pallets: followed by lots.

u3l11.title: Odd or even gate
u3l11.story: Store gate number 17, use % 2 to get the remainder after dividing by 2, and print Remainder: followed by the remainder. (A remainder of 1 means an odd gate.)

u3l11.title: Odd or even
u3l11.story: Store 42 in seat. Use % 2 to get the remainder in rest and print Remainder: followed by rest. (A remainder of 1 means odd. 0 means even.)

u3l11.title: Odd or even
u3l11.story: Store 9 in num. Use % 2 to get the remainder in left and print Remainder: followed by left. (A remainder of 1 means odd. 0 means even.)

u3l11.title: Last digit
u3l11.story: Store 4821 in number. Use % 10 to get the last digit in digit, and print Last digit: followed by digit.

u3l11.title: Last digit
u3l11.story: Store 307 in code. Use % 10 to get the last digit in last, and print Last digit: followed by last.

u3l11.title: Leftover items
u3l11.story: Store 47 in packages and 10 in per_box. Use % to get the number LEFT OVER after filling groups of per_box, store it in leftover, and print leftover.

u3l11.title: Leftover items
u3l11.story: Store 31 in items and 6 in per_bag. Use % to get the number LEFT OVER after filling groups of per_bag, store it in extra, and print extra.

u3l11.title: Hours and minutes
u3l11.story: Store 95 in trip. Use // 60 for the whole hours in h and % 60 for the leftover minutes in m. Print them joined like 1h 35m (the hours, then "h ", then the minutes, then "m").

u3l11.title: Flight time
u3l11.story: Delta shows flight time as hours and minutes. Store 135 total minutes, use // 60 for the hours and % 60 for the leftover minutes, and print them like 2h 15m.

u3l11.title: Hours and minutes
u3l11.story: Store 200 in mins. Use // 60 for the whole hours in hrs and % 60 for the leftover minutes in left. Print them joined like 1h 35m (the hours, then "h ", then the minutes, then "m").

u3l12.title: Range estimate
u3l12.story: Tesla's range estimate: store the battery percent (80), then compute range_miles as the battery times 3, plus 20. Print the range. (Multiplication happens before addition.)

u3l12.title: Range estimate
u3l12.story: Store 50 in charge. Work out distance as charge times 4, plus 10 (multiplication happens before addition), and print distance.

u3l12.title: Range estimate
u3l12.story: Store 12 in gas. Work out miles as gas times 25, plus 30 (multiplication happens before addition), and print miles.

u3l12.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
u3l12.story: Store 20 degrees Celsius in temp_c. Convert it: multiply by 9, divide by 5, then add 32. Store the result in temp_f and print it.

u3l12.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
u3l12.story: Store 100 in c. Convert it to Fahrenheit: multiply by 9, divide by 5, then add 32. Store the result in f and print f.

u3l12.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
u3l12.story: Store 0 in celsius. Convert it to Fahrenheit: multiply by 9, divide by 5, then add 32. Store the result in fahrenheit and print fahrenheit.

u3l12.title: Fee before the count
u3l12.story: Store 10 in price and 3 in count. Add 2 to price BEFORE multiplying by count (use parentheses), store the result in total, and print total.

u3l12.title: Fee before the count
u3l12.story: Store 8 in cost and 4 in tickets. Add 1 to cost BEFORE multiplying by tickets (use parentheses), store the result in bill, and print bill.

u3l12.title: Subtract, then divide
u3l12.story: Store 50 in big and 10 in small. Subtract first, then divide by 4 (use parentheses): store the result in rest and print rest.

u3l12.title: Subtract, then divide
u3l12.story: Store 100 in total and 20 in used. Subtract first, then divide by 5 (use parentheses): store the result in left and print left.

u3l13.title: Robux after two changes
u3l13.story: Roblox: start with 100 Robux, add 50, then spend 30 (subtract 30). Keep using the same variable the whole time, and print what is left.

u3l13.title: Running balance
u3l13.story: Store 20 in coins. Add 5 to coins, then subtract 8 from coins (keep using the same variable), and print coins.

u3l13.title: Running balance
u3l13.story: Store 0 in points. Add 12 to points, then subtract 4 from points (keep using the same variable), and print points.

u3l13.title: Running total
u3l13.story: Start total at 0. Add 5, then 10, then 15 to total (one line each), and print total.

u3l13.title: Running total
u3l13.story: Start sum at 0. Add 2, then 4, then 6 to sum (one line each), and print sum.

u3l13.title: Buy, then double the price
u3l13.story: Store robux (100) and price (40). Spend the price first (subtract it from robux), and THEN double the price. Print robux, then print the new price.

u3l13.title: Spend, then double the price
u3l13.story: Store 50 in wallet and 12 in cost. Subtract cost from wallet first, and THEN double cost. Print wallet, then print cost.

u3l13.title: Spend, then double the price
u3l13.story: Store 80 in cash and 15 in fee. Subtract fee from cash first, and THEN double fee. Print cash, then print fee.

u3l13.title: Swap with temp
u3l13.story: Store 3 in left and 8 in right. Swap them using a variable called temp so neither value is lost. Print left, then print right.

u3l13.title: Swap with temp
u3l13.story: Store 10 in x and 20 in y. Swap them using a variable called temp so neither value is lost. Print x, then print y.
